top_signals.title: SailGP Launches UAE Team, Aims to Grow to 20 Teams
top_signals.summary: SailGP CEO and founder Russell Coutts discusses the launch of a UAE team for the 2027 season and the league’s plans to expand to 20 teams and more than 20 events. He also talks about team economics, investor conflicts and SailGP’s growth strategy with Abeer Abu Omar on Bloomberg’s “Horizons Middle East and Africa.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Saudi-Houthi Fighting Intensifies
top_signals.summary: The Houthis injured 11 people with an attack on a tower in Riyadh’s main business district on Tuesday, Saudi Arabian authorities said. The assault came less than a week after the headquarters of the nation’s Public Investment Fund was damaged by the Iran-backed Yemeni group. Bloomberg's Onur Ant reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
top_signals.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in 2027. At a forecast 505,000 b/d in 2027, output would be the most since 2014.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
top_signals.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
